item.text: The loader starts from `Default()` and applies Viper keys individually. I’ll add `metadata.check_for_updates` through that path, so omitted settings keep the enabled default, then cover YAML and JSON in the loader tests.

item.text:
Added `metadata.check_for_updates` to Flipt’s configuration. It defaults to `true` and can be set to `false` in YAML or JSON.

Verified with `go test ./config` and `go test ./cmd/flipt ./config`.
